content:
emma: Morning team  planning a brief release in the small change window tonight (02:00-03:30 UTC). Goal: publish py/ts SDK patch with types pin and deprecation blurb. Need confirmation on pin strategy for @types package and the rollback trigger.

raj: I can take watch. For types we should pin the `@types/redwood` to the last-known-good commit during publish, then publish a separate `types-compat` tag. That avoids float issues for downstream.

emma: Good call. Proposed dist-tags: `stable-nightdrop` -> normal publish, `stable-rollback` -> emergency fallback. We will set npm dist-tag atomically after sign.

deploy-bot: Preflight: CI: green, e2e: 12/12, types-check: OK on main. Artifacts staged at s3://redwood-releases/nightdrop/1714023456/.

tina: Quick note on rollback criteria: any TS compile failures in downstream integration or any runtime import errors in the smoke harness -> initiate rollback. Also treat any pip wheel integrity errors as immediate rollback.

mike: Suggest adding an automated types-check step that runs `tsc --noEmit` against sample consumer repo and fails fast. I can add that to the smoke run.

emma: Commands for publish (copied to runbook):

```
# dry-run
./scripts/publish_all.sh --packages py,ts --dist-tag stable-nightdrop --dry-run
# sign + publish
./scripts/publish_all.sh --packages py,ts --dist-tag stable-nightdrop --sign --rotate-token
# pin types (npm)
npm dist-tag add @types/redwood@1.2.3 types-compat
```

raj: For pypi rollback remember we have the yank process: `twine remove` isn't a thing; use `pypi yanked` workflow + purge from artifactory if we proxied. I'll coordinate with security to ensure the wheel is removed from internal caches.

docs-bot: Draft release notes created: `docs/releases/nightdrop-1714023456.md`. Section added: "Deprecation: legacy sync client" with migration snippet and minimal code example.

emma: OK. Watch handoff: Raj on primary watch, Mike runs TS consumer smoke, Tina monitors wheel checksums and pushes, I'll be the rollback owner. Timeout: 03:00 UTC forced rollback if untriaged high-sev.

mike: Running the consumer check locally now: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/example-consumer && yarn && tsc --noEmit`. Will post results.

deploy-bot: publish-preview: dist-tag `stable-nightdrop` not yet moved. Artifacts signed but not released. Checksums verified.

mike: consumer tsc OK locally. No import regressions.

emma: Proceeding with signed publish in 5m. Reminder: rotate ephemeral token after publish. Use runbook snippet: `aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id nightdrop-token --secret-string "<rotated>"`.

raj: If rollback: steps -> move dist-tag (`npm dist-tag add package@<old> stable-nightdrop && npm dist-tag rm package stable-nightdrop`), yank wheel from pypi, re-publish stable from `release/v1.2.2` branch, notify integrators, open follow-up thread.

tina: Also create a short note for #integrations with the exact commands we ran and the new package versions so customers can pin to stable if needed.

emma: Thanks everyone 4AA starting publish now, I'll post back the dist-tag move once done. :thumbsup:

(Short automated updates from deploy-bot after publish would follow as separate messages with timestamps; omitted here.)
